public_probe_interpretation: A low-volume functional probe is not a load or rate-limit proof; no abuse traffic was generated.
risk: A client can exhaust the account-wide Free Function quota and deny read-only API availability; public 1027 can be detected after exhaustion, but anonymous per-client requests cannot be durably throttled on this pages.dev host with current approved infrastructure.
mitigations: GET-only public data with bounded response and pagination
No wallet, signing, payment, private data, or upstream RPC invocation in the Pages Function
Cloudflare Browser Integrity Check on Pages and hard Workers Free daily quota
Public scheduled health and quota-exhaustion detection after workflow reaches the default branch
Manual rollback or disablement by the authorized staging operator
proposed_acceptance: Explicitly accept denial-of-service exposure for a public read-only Devnet preview only; do not extend this acceptance to financial operations, private data, or Mainnet.
